name: theme-editing-all-extensions
description: The theme editor's built-in sample document — the same text and theme as the theme-editing fixture — rendered with EVERY shipped extension enabled at once. Two guarantees ride on this. First, no extension may be offered whose effect the sample cannot show — every shipped extension has to produce a visible difference in the sample preview when it is switched on — so the sample must carry the targeting markup each extension acts on; a sample that had lost an attribute would render here identically to theme-editing and the difference between the two references would show it. Second, enabling every shipped extension at once must render successfully and no pair of them may produce a result that depends on which loaded first: nine extensions prepended onto one converter must compose, and the back-matter ones must produce the same page order however they were loaded — the licence page and the colophon each drew from the same hook and did NOT, before the ranked back-matter queue. The pair with theme-editing is the whole point: same source, same theme, extensions the only variable.
